items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Bill did snap some pictures there. Yeah. He was on at the next corner down there.

ctx.x: Plays piano too, huh, I bet.
No, I don't know, I don't know she's interested in music or not. What, Bill?
I thought you said all your nieces play.
